name: test-runner-b2-collapse-smoke-npm-scripts
title: B2: collapse the per-smoke test:* npm scripts into smoke-manifest entries
description: B2 of the test-runner consolidation sub-program. Per the A0 decision doc (B-35aa: docs/requirements/decisions/test-runner-consolidation-plan.md): collapse the 143 individual `test:X-smoke` npm scripts in packages/main/package.json and their 44 redundant root-level proxy entries into smoke-manifest.json entries. Each collapse: add a manifest row (or accept the directory-scan default) — then remove the per-smoke npm script. Operators run a smoke via `npm run test:all -- --select <name>` instead of `npm run test:X-smoke`. KEEP (do NOT collapse): root `test` main script + the 5 named scripts it invokes (test:main-write-lock-coverage / test:review-convergence-smoke / test:review-incremental-context-smoke / test:docs-drift-smoke / test:e2e) + test:all + test:run-all-smokes-smoke + 49 scripts/verify-*.mjs (out of B2 scope, follow-up). Also keep a thin compatibility shim `npm run test:legacy -- <name>` per the A0 doc.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: keyword migration only appears in the phrase 'migration command' describing the CHANGELOG entry's user-facing wording (e.g. 'use npm run test:legacy -- X instead of test:X-smoke'). This story performs zero data migration, file migration, or database migration. It is a script-level mechanical refactor: delete redundant npm scripts, add manifest entries, no data semantics change.
